endpoints.name: greenlake_blueprints_list
endpoints.description: Returns list of blueprints

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set. Default is 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The numbers of items to return. Default is 0 which means no limit.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
The filter query parameter is used to filter the set of resources returned in the response. 
The returned set of resources must match the criteria in the filter query parameter.
A comparision compares a property name to a literal. 
The comparisons supported are the following:
- "eq" : Is a property equal to value. Valid for number, boolean and string properties.
- "gt" : Is a property greater than a value. Valid for number or string timestamp properties.
- "lt" : Is a property less than a value. Valid for number or string timestamp properties.
- "in" : Is a value in a property (that is an array of strings).
- GET /storage-fleet/v1alpha1/setup-blueprints?filter=name eq 'blueprint_device1'

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: A list of properties to include in the response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Instruct the server to sort the resources returned with a collection-level GET. They provide sorting by one or more properties in ascending or descending order. Each item in the “sort” query parameter is a property name optionally followed by a direction indicator. The direction indicator may only be either “asc” (ascending) or “desc” (descending). If no direction indicator is specified, the default order is ascending. The first item in the “sort” query parameter defines the primary sort order, the second defines the secondary sort order, the third defines the tertiary sort order, etc.

endpoints.name: greenlake_devices_list
endpoints.description:
Returns a list of devices associated with the customer that have yet to be or have just been initialized.
This includes devices that are:
 - onboarded
 - uninitialized
 - initializing
 - initialized (Note that such devices will only be shown for a short period of time)
 - initialization_failed

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set. Default is 20.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The numbers of items to return. Default is 0 which means no limit.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
The filter query parameter is used to filter the set of resources returned in the response. 
The returned set of resources must match the criteria in the filter query parameter.
A comparision compares a property name to a literal. 
The comparisons supported are the following:
- "eq" : Is a property equal to value. Valid for number, boolean and string properties.
- "ne" : Is a property not equal to value. Valid for number, boolean and string properties.
- "gt" : Is a property greater than a value. Valid for number or string timestamp properties.
- "lt" : Is a property less than a value. Valid for number or string timestamp properties.

Properties that can be filtered are:
- name
- blueprintId
- description
- model
- associatedBlueprint.name
- autoSetup
- connectionStatus
- status
- type
- createdAt
- updatedAt
- generation

Examples are:
- GET /storage-fleet/v1alpha1/setup-devices?filter=status eq 'ONBOARDED'
- GET /storage-fleet/v1alpha1/setup-devices?filter=updatedAt lt 2021-04-08T16:51:33Z
- GET /storage-fleet/v1alpha1/setup-devices?filter=status eq 'ONBOARDED' and createdAt lt 2021-04-08T16:51:33Z
- GET /storage-fleet/v1alpha1/setup-devices?filter=status ne 'UNINITIALIZED'

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: A list of properties to include in the response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Instruct the server to sort the resources returned with a collection-level GET. They provide sorting by one or more properties in ascending or descending order.
Each item in the “sort” query parameter is a property name optionally followed by a direction indicator. The direction indicator may only be either “asc” (ascending) or 
“desc” (descending). If no direction indicator is specified, the default order is ascending.
The first item in the “sort” query parameter defines the primary sort order, the second defines the secondary sort order, the third defines the tertiary sort order, etc. 

Properties that can be sorted are:
- name
- blueprintId
- id
- serialNumber
- name
- description
- model
- type
- connectionStatus
- associatedBlueprint.name
- status
- autoSetup
- createdAt
- updatedAt
- generation
